changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwemergencytriage AS SELECT et.id, et.patient_id, et.encounter_id, et.emergency_level, et.right_eye_light_response, et.right_eye_pupil_size, et.left_eye_light_response, et.left_eye_pupil_size, et.hpi_additional_notes, et.life_saving, et.unresponsive, et.high_risk, et.avpu_scale, et.pain_score, et.labs_required, et.imaging_required, et.iv_fluids_required, et.medication_required, et.ecg_required, et.consultation_required, et.destination, et.completed_date, et.created_by, et.created_date, et.last_modified_by, et.last_modified_date FROM public.emergency_triage et;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwemergencytriage TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwemergencytriage FROM report_user;
